practical_problems.note: benchmark measures decision-making scores across four tiers up to full decision paths with domain constraints; scores are judged, not a cost or utility outcome calibration: judged scores, no cost or utility variation or mechanism ablation.

evidence.quote: bottleneck. Most models achieve high Code Correctness but score much lower on other dimensions,

practical_problems.note: direct versus code-enabled comparison and factual-verification and code-correctness dimensions against verifiable reference answers calibration: code-correctness and judged dimensions, no human or faithfulness evaluation.

summary: TimeSage-MT is a multi-turn benchmark with verifiable targets and a reference agent; it shows frontier LLMs and a skill-library agent drop sharply on decision-oriented turns and that code execution beats direct answering, without a per-family result.
